pkgmetadata.longdescription: libpurple 2.14 from the pidgin-gtk4 tree: an ABI-compatible superset of the stock 2.14.14 library with modern XMPP (carbons, MAM, HTTP upload, receipts and markers, corrections, reactions, replies, OMEMO) and IRCv3 support. The GTK 2 Pidgin is not built; the user interface is net-im/pidgin4. Profiles in ~/.purple stay readable by the stock Pidgin 2.14.14.

use.flag: Pull in the GTK 4 user interface, net-im/pidgin4
Build the OMEMO end-to-end encryption plugin for XMPP (net-libs/libomemo-c)
